key_path: fill the test-account form at adyen.com/signup (company/contact details); Adyen warns a test account does not guarantee approval
receive login instructions by email, set password and 2FA for the test Customer Area
Developers > API credentials > create/select web service user (ws_...@Company.X)
Generate API key (and client key for frontend)
live: 'apply for live' -> underwriting approval, signed contract, data-security attestation

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no - MCP is local, API key only
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - Management API can create API credentials and generate API keys (needs an existing key with the right roles)

mcp.type: product MCP (Checkout + Management API subset), labelled alpha on GitHub

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - append .md; pages carry YAML frontmatter and a 'For LLMs' SDK-version note
docs_for_agents.other: Documentation and knowledge tools page; Postman collections

time_to_first_call_minutes.note: can be days if the test-account request is reviewed

score_justification: Excellent agent-readable docs, but enterprise sales-led onboarding, mandatory 2FA and a local-only alpha MCP keep agents out of the first mile.
best_practice: Every docs page has a .md twin with machine frontmatter (source_url, last_modified) plus an in-page 'For LLMs' instruction.
biggest_gap: No self-serve instant sandbox and no remote/OAuth MCP; MCP docs last modified 2025-06 (looks stale).
